pt.headline: Arrifana oferece as melhores ondas do dia
pt.advice: Com ondas de 4.3 m, vento moderado e água a 18.5 °C, Arrifana está em condição segura (aviso amarelo). Evite os spots com alerta laranja e surf na melhor hora por volta das 09:30. Use fato 3/2 mm e fique atento à presença de pescadores.
pt.crowdTip: Chegue cedo; o pico ainda está pouco cheio.

en.headline: Arrifana serves the day’s best surf
en.advice: With 4.3 m waves, moderate wind and 18.5 °C water, Arrifana is safe (yellow alert). Skip the spots with orange warnings and hit the peak around 09:30. Wear a 3/2 mm wetsuit and watch for local fishing activity.
en.crowdTip: Get there early; the line‑up is still light.
en.moonTideLine: Waxing gibbous · Neap tides · low tide 16:00
